notes: One murderer against everyone else is Survival's asymmetric-roles case, so 1 vs All is the preset and spawn-protected is what keeps the killer and the hunted from starting on top of each other; Party & Casual is named second because this is also a round-based social game, and it is the only loaded file with somewhere for eliminated players to wait. Shape is warren-looping rather than interior-single: the mansion is one enclosed building, but a chase decided by who gets cornered cannot ship a topology an image might leave with dead ends, so the loop connectivity has to be valid by construction — that P6 is proven and stays. I dropped the preset's gate-escape because the author was offered survivors escaping through a door and explicitly declined it. Deciding without a user: the round's end is a player-state condition — murderer caught, or everyone eliminated — so there is no exit or objective geometry to place, which is worth watching for reachability validation; the threat is a player rather than AI so no hostile spawner is emitted, I added a lobby as the between-rounds gathering space, and 'dim and gothic' is art direction rather than layout.
